verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's CLI `init` writes skill files into the project for both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills). The docs say those files can be committed so the whole team shares the setup, and a keyless dry-run probe confirmed both targets are generated. missing for 10: no marketplace or plugin-registry channel, the distributed skill set is limited to Ultrametric's own skill rather than a team-curated set, and there is no hands-on check of an actual write-and-commit flow beyond the dry-run preview.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: You can commit the skill files to share the setup with your team.
